ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.label: sweat room
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.description: A small closed room with a heater (or a campfire before electricity) and a few stools: a sauna of the colony's own.
ColonyCouncil.RoomTemplateDef.purpose: Somewhere hot to sit at the end of a cold day. Colonists come here to warm through on cold days, and talk while they do.

tips.li: It counts as a sauna at 28 °C or more: turn the heater's target up once it's built. A campfire can only warm a room to about 23 °C, so with a fire, as warm as the fire makes it counts.
Keep it small (30 cells at most), the door shut, and no bed or workbench in it, or it's just another room.
On cold days, colonists with time to spare come and sit in it a while (with "Small habits" on), and chat with whoever else is in there.
